questions.cardDe: Es gibt nur einen offiziell anerkannten Jakobsweg, der Pilger nach Santiago de Compostela führt. Richtig oder falsch?

questions.en: What is the name of the classic main route of the Way of St. James, leading from the Pyrenees across northern Spain to Santiago de Compostela?

timeline.labelEn: The Camino Francés to Santiago de Compostela is inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site
timeline.labelDe: Der Camino Francés nach Santiago de Compostela wird UNESCO-Welterbe

questions.notes: True/false removed: the statement is false — 'Jakobsweg' names a whole network of pilgrim routes through Europe to Santiago, chief among them the Camino Francés (nearly 800 km).

timeline.labelEn: Lobster starts to become sought after in America, having long been food for the poor, servants and prisoners
